Bull. 2516, Evaporation Loss from Low-Pressure Tanks, 1962 Breathing, working, and leakage losses encountered in low-pressure tanks (atmospheric to 15 psig) are discussed in this bulletin, which also provides equations for calculating these values. 12 pages.

Price each, $3.00

852-25170

Publ 2517, Evaporation Loss from External Floating-Roof Tanks, Second Edition, 1980

A method of estimating total evaporative stock loss from volatile stocks stored in external floating roof storage tanks is presented along with a description of roofs and seals and details of loss analysis. 29 pages.

Price each, $7.00
